note: Formulas for the first line. Use the shape, never the words of a reel you studied. 'seen' is a real view count from a reel using this shape, as a sign of the shape's reach, not a promise.

formulas.name: The kill
formulas.shape: [Tool or trend] just killed [thing everyone knows].

formulas.name: The number
formulas.shape: [Big number] from [one small thing], without [what people assume you need].
formulas.example: One reel, 115 million views, without showing a face.
formulas.seen: 115.9M is a real reel; the sentence is ours

formulas.name: The proof
formulas.best_for: A real result you can show
formulas.example: A reel made with Claude got 6.5 million views in a month.

formulas.name: It happened to me
formulas.shape: [Tool or person] did [surprising thing] to me.
formulas.example: Claude deleted me from the internet.

formulas.name: I'll prove it
formulas.example: Claude is a yes-man. I'll prove it.

formulas.name: The question nobody asked
formulas.shape: A question the viewer can't answer but now wants to.
formulas.example: How many people did it take to make you?

formulas.name: The real-life why
formulas.shape: Why does [annoying everyday thing] keep happening?
formulas.best_for: Anything the viewer has lived through
formulas.example: Where do loan callers get your number from?

formulas.name: Two sides
formulas.shape: [Word A] | [Word B], shown side by side.

formulas.name: The private moment
formulas.shape: What [someone close] did when [they thought you weren't looking].
formulas.example: What your mother said when she thought you were asleep.

formulas.name: Instant recognition
formulas.shape: A tiny moment everyone knows, described exactly.
formulas.example: You explain it clearly in an email, then you hear that call sound.

formulas.name: The object truth
formulas.best_for: Object-based stories, which this pack draws best
formulas.example: Your phone at 1% gets a charger straight away. You at 1% get another cup of tea.
